title: Crematory Operators
description: Operate crematory equipment to reduce human or animal remains to bone fragments in accordance with state and local regulations. Duties may include preparing the body for cremation and performing general maintenance on crematory equipment. May use traditional flame-based cremation, calcination, or alkaline hydrolysis.

tasks.text: Clean the crematorium, including tables, floors, and equipment.
Pick up and handle human or pet remains in a respectful manner.
Place corpses into crematory machines to reduce remains to bone fragments using flame, heat, or alkaline hydrolysis.
Sweep or vacuum the cremation chamber to retrieve remains for storage in an urn or other container.
Document divided remains to ensure parts are not misplaced.
Embalm, dress, or otherwise prepare the deceased for viewing.

clusters.label: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Explain the cremation process to family or friends of the deceased.

clusters.label: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Offer counsel and comfort to bereaved families or friends.
Pulverize remaining bone fragments into smaller pieces, using specialized equipment, such as a cremulator or grinder.
Read documentation to confirm the identity of the deceased.
Remove jewelry, watches, or other personal items from the deceased prior to cremation.
Transport the deceased to a funeral home or crematory using a van, hearse, or other vehicle.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Belmar & Associates Mortware, HMIS Advantage.
